pr.title: [api] Add timing collection and dump via environment variable
pr.body: Adds a `TS_API_TIMING_DIR` environment variable that causes the API client to collect timing info and write its results out to a file upon closing. I'm working on gathering an API benchmarking suite we can run on PRs with `@typescript-bot api perf test this` or something.
commits: Add opt-in API timing collection dumps
Preserve API timing dumps when server timing is unavailable
Handle unavailable server timing during API shutdown
Reject sync API I/O after unrecoverable callback failures
